title: Trees Can Sense Their Shape and Straighten Up
paragraphs: Trees can feel their own shape. A new study from France shows this.
Scientists used young poplar trees. First, the trees grew bent. Then the scientists put them on a slowly turning platform. The platform hides light and gravity.
After some weeks, the trees became straight. They made special wood on the bent side. This wood pulls the tree back. Trees have a kind of muscle.
